memberdef.name: writeRenderData

briefdescription.para: Holds the data points of one series and derives everything that depends only on them.

detaileddescription.para: A data point is a fixed number of coordinate columns, each tied to the X or Y dimension, plus optional float attributes and an optional integer category. The store keeps the coordinates at the precision they were given in and derives:

listitem.para: the extents of the valid coordinates under one of three range rules;

the float render data uploaded to the GPU. Float input is its own render data. Double input is uploaded relative to a render origin per dimension, which moves to the viewport center when the viewport gets too far from it. Logarithmic dimensions are never shifted.

detaileddescription.para: Render data is rebuilt lazily, the first time it is read after something it depends on changed, so even its const readers may rebuild it. The store is not thread-safe: use it from the series' thread, or from updatePaintNode() while that thread is blocked.
